name: prism-bloom
note: The prism preset's post: soft wide bloom and the widest, most saturated halo for the gems' light, chromatic aberration as the dispersion, lens dirt catching the glow, and a void toe sinking the lit world toward black (neon-look-style.md, Post); calm since ps-wnj.24: bloom and halo cut less than the other options' 30% (bloom 0.7 to 0.6, halo 0.9 to 0.8: thin emitters, which at 70% fell under the bright-share floor in the crystal cut), the beat a third, the full flash for special moments and a calm moment's at 30% of it (neon-look-style.md, Restraint). The halo flares to 2.5x its own on a special moment's first frame (halo.special), and the lens's chromatic aberration is 0.04, not 0.2: its rainbow fringes broke the cut's key and palette conformance (ps-wnj.19).
